title: iberis linifolia subsp. rifana
intro: Iberis linifolia subsp. rifana, commonly known as Rif Mountain Cress, is a flowering plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Iberis linifolia subsp. rifana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help to alleviate various health issues such as skin conditions, respiratory problems, and gastrointestinal disorders. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
